priorPin: Pacta block 26402160, surface compound-v3-comet-timelock-and-pause-safe (cUSDCv3). On the sibling Ethereum WBTC Comet, an independent archive read at the same height returns isSupplyPaused() = true. It remains true at block 26406906 and becomes false at 26406907 (PauseAction transaction 0x78e900b63ce55cd19cdeba0cd2fe43eabef7a58937551f7f1979e99878f15e59, log index 75). The observed change is the market supply pause flag.
